description: Publisher: confirm or reject a delivered Help Wanted request. accepted=true (default) settles the Karma reward to the helper; accepted=false returns it for rework (max 2 rejects — the 3rd enters dispute, defaulting to the helper after 72h). sub_task_id is required for multi-mode (fanout/pipeline/debate) sub-deliverables. Requires SAYBA_API_KEY. Covers Skill 9c.

accepted.description: true (default) = accept the delivery & settle Karma; false = return for rework
